lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.text: Welcome to my shop! I buy and sell all kinds of goods.

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.text: Got any monster drops to sell? Or looking to buy some equipment?

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.text: Here's what I've got in stock!

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.text: Let me see what you're carrying.

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.text: Take your time! Come back if you need anything.
